cp14:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Cūḷabodhi Susīlavā bhavaṃ disvāna bhayato nekkhammaṃ abhinikkhamiṃ. || ||
cp14:2.1: Yā me dutiyikā āsi brāhmaṇī kanakasannibhā sā pi vaṭṭe anapekkhā nekkhammaṃ abhinikkhami. || ||
cp14:3.1: Nirālayā chinnabandhū anapekkhā kule gaṇe carantā gāmanigamaṃ Bārāṇasim-upāgamuṃ. || ||
cp14:4.1: Tattha vasāma nipakā asaṃsaṭṭhā kule gaṇe nirākule appasadde rāj' uyyāne vasām' ubho. || ||
cp14:5.1: Uyyānadassanaṃ gantvā rājā addasa brāhmaṇiṃ upagamma mamaṃ pucchi: tuyh' esā, kassa bhāriyā. || ||
cp14:6.1: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ tassa idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ: na mayhaṃ bhariyā esā sahadhammā ekasāsanī. || ||
cp14:7.1: Tassā Sārattagadhito gāhāpetvāna ceṭake nippīḷayanto balasā antepuram-pavesayi. || ||
cp14:8.1: Odapattakiyā mayhaṃ sahajā ekasāsanī ākaḍḍhitvā nayantiyā kopo me upapajjatha. || ||
cp14:9.1: Saha kope samuppanne sīlabbatam-anussariṃ tatth' eva kopaṃ niggaṇhiṃ nādāsiṃ vaḍḍhit' ūpari. || ||
cp14:10.1: Yadi naṃ brāhmaṇiṃ koci koṭṭeyya tiṇhasattiyā n' eva sīlaṃ pabhindeyyaṃ bodhiyā-yeva kāraṇā. || ||
cp14:11.1: Na me sā brāhmaṇī dessā na pi me balaṃ na vijjati, sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā sīlānurakkhissan-ti. || ||
